# CGK Accounting Services

> Owner-operated accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation and small business consulting firm
> based at 1 Hollow Oak Drive, East Patchogue, New York 11772, serving individuals and small
> businesses across Long Island (Suffolk and Nassau County). Founded March 12, 2014 by
> Christopher G. "Chris" Kamine. Office: (631) 908-5130. Website:
> https://www.cgkaccountingservices.com/

## Key facts

- **Business name:** CGK Accounting Services
- **Owner and sole practitioner:** Christopher G. Kamine (Chris Kamine)
- **Founded:** March 12, 2014; Chris has prepared returns for personal clients since 2008
- **Address:** 1 Hollow Oak Drive, East Patchogue, NY 11772, United States
- **Office phone:** (631) 908-5130
- **Cell phone:** (631) 942-5375
- **Fax:** (631) 223-0665
- **Service area:** Long Island, New York — primarily Suffolk County and Nassau County
- **Positioning:** Charges substantially less than larger accounting firms; advice and
  consultations are always free; calls and emails returned the same business day, guaranteed
- **Slogan:** "Because managing your financial affairs should not be a puzzle."

## Who the firm serves

Individuals and families, self-employed filers and contractors, LLCs, S corporations and C
corporations, partnerships, non-profit organizations, and new or closing businesses.

CGK Accounting Services also has direct experience working with **fire districts and EMS agencies**. These public-service organizations operate under tighter
recordkeeping and reporting expectations than a typical small business, and Chris Kamine's
fifteen years in public accounting — reaching the position of audit manager — apply directly to
that work.

## Credentials

- Registered tax return preparer with the State of New York
- Registered tax return preparer with the IRS
- Certified by the IRS as an authorized e-filing firm
- Accredited business with an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau
- Carries general liability and professional liability (malpractice) insurance
- BBA in Accounting, Dowling College, 2003; working in accounting since 2000
- 15 years in public accounting at CPA firms, reaching audit manager; also served as Corporate
  Controller and VP of Finance at private companies on Long Island

Note: CGK Accounting Services is an accounting and tax preparation firm. It is not described as
a CPA firm, and Chris Kamine is not represented as a Certified Public Accountant.

## Services

- [Tax preparation and planning](https://www.cgkaccountingservices.com/tax.html): individual,
  self-employed, corporate (C and S corporation), partnership and non-profit Form 990 returns;
  annual W-2 and 1099 filing; assistance with IRS and New York State notices. Returns are e-filed
  only after all e-file authorization forms are signed, dated and received, and payment in full
  is received.
- [Bookkeeping](https://www.cgkaccountingservices.com/bookkeeping.html): four engagement levels —
  weekly onsite, monthly, quarterly (most popular) and annual (most affordable). A complete set
  of books is always provided to the client, electronically or in hardcopy. CGK can act as an
  accounting department, controller or CFO.
- [Accounting and financial statements](https://www.cgkaccountingservices.com/accounting.html):
  preparation of meaningful financial statements the owner can read and use, with an income
  statement and balance sheet walkthrough at the conclusion of every engagement.
- [Business consulting](https://www.cgkaccountingservices.com/consulting.html): business
  start-ups and entity selection (LLC, corporation, partnership, proprietorship), sales tax
  registration, EIN applications, Department of Labor payroll registration, QuickBooks
  installation and chart-of-accounts setup, business dissolutions, and general business advice.

## Key filing deadlines referenced on the site

- Personal income tax return: April 15
- Estimated income taxes: April 15, June 15, September 15, January 15
- Corporate tax return (C and S corporations): March 15
- Corporate estimated taxes: March 15, June 15, September 15, December 15
- Non-profit Form 990: May 15
- Sales tax — annual: March 20; quarterly: March 20, June 20, September 20, December 20;
  monthly filers: the 20th of each month
- Quarterly payroll tax returns: April 30, July 30, October 31, January 31
- Annual payroll tax returns: January 31
- W-2 and 1099 recipient copies: January 31; IRS copies: February 28

These dates are general guidance. Deadlines shift for weekends and holidays and vary by filer.
